name: maximum_entropy_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, a 5-second return that falls beyond the 95th percentile of the past 5-minute return distribution represents a statistically anomalous flush of market orders — typically cascading stop-loss triggers or short-term momentum algos overshooting on thin liquidity. The maximum entropy distribution (approximated via Cornish-Fisher expansion using rolling mean, std, and skewness) correctly identifies when positive or negative skew makes an event truly extreme rather than just 'large under a normal assumption.' Within 30-90 seconds, NIFTY's structural mean-reversion forces (VWAP-anchored institutional accumulation, market-maker delta-hedging from gamma exposure) fade these overshoots.
core_signal_oneliner: 5-second return crossing the skewness-adjusted Cornish-Fisher P5 or P95 threshold of the rolling 5-minute return distribution, signaling a statistically extreme move to revert
